context.content: Hi there! What genre or type of movie are you in the mood for today?
Hey there! I'm in the mood for an action-packed movie. Preferably something thrilling and maybe with a bit of a twist.
It seems like you might enjoy "After Hours" (1985). It's got a lot of twists and turns, and it's quite thrilling!
"After Hours"? Sounds intriguing. Can you tell me more about it? Like, what's the plot about and who are the main characters?

"After Hours" follows a young man who stays in a nightclub past closing time and finds himself in a series of strange and dangerous situations. The main character, played by John Cusack, navigates through various encounters that keep him on edge. It's full of surprises!
That sounds right up my alley! I like the idea of a protagonist getting into all sorts of trouble. Do you know if it has any action sequences?
Yes, it does! There are some great action sequences where the main character gets involved in physical confrontations. It's really well-paced and keeps you engaged throughout.
Great! I'm definitely interested in this one. Can you give me the release date and the director's name?
"After Hours" was released in 1985 and was directed by John Landis.
1985, got it. Directed by John Landis. Sounds like a classic. I think I'll go with this one. [END] Thanks for the recommendation! I'm excited to watch it. Have a great day!
